{{Short description|17th season of Danish Superliga}}

The '''2006–07 Danish Superliga''' season was the 17th season of the [[Danish Superliga]] league championship, which determined the winners of the [[Danish football champions]]hip. It was governed by the [[Danish Football Association]]. It took place from the first match on July 19, 2006 to the final match on May 27, 2007. The ending date was discussed to be postponed to mid-June, if the [[Denmark under-21 national football team|Danish under-21 national team]] missed qualification for the [[UEFA U-21 Championship 2007]],<ref>{{in lang|da}} Lars Berendt, [http://dbu.dk/news/newsShow.aspx?id=232487 SAS Ligaen starter 19. juli] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110807091332/http://dbu.dk/news/newsShow.aspx?id=232487 |date=2011-08-07 }}, ''Danish FA'', 2006-05-02</ref> as they did, but instead the date was moved from [[Pentecost]] Monday to Pentecost Sunday.<ref>{{in lang|da}} Allan Gundsø Hansen, [http://www.dbu.dk/news/newsShow.aspx?id=237862 SAS Ligaens sidste spillerunde fremrykkes], ''Danish FA'', 2007-03-20</ref>

The Danish champions qualified for [[UEFA Champions League 2007–08]] qualification. The runners-up qualified for [[UEFA Cup 2007–08]] qualification. The third-place finishers qualified for the [[UEFA Intertoto Cup 2007]]. The 11th and 12th placed teams were [[relegated]] to the [[Danish 1st Division|1st Division]]. The 1st Division champions and runners-up are [[promotion and relegation|promoted]] to the Superliga.

The fixture schedule can be seen [http://www.dbu.dk/sr/programComplete.aspx?poolid=35621 here] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060630104613/http://www.dbu.dk/sr/programComplete.aspx?poolid=35621 |date=2006-06-30 }}.
